mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS increases by > 200k in a month, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating a surge in housing demand, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 60 trading days due to the ripple effect on related industries.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% and CPIAUCSL growth is < 2% YoY, signaling accommodative monetary policy without inflation pressure, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 4.0%, indicating a very strong labor market, leads to increased wage pressures and, subsequently, to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated reduced profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in RSAFS, indicating rising retail sales, boosts market sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
